summary: Read a binary search tree together with two different nodes p and q. Every node value is unique, and both p and q are present. Values in a left subtree are smaller than the parent, and values in a right subtree are larger. Find a node x that is a forebear of p and also a forebear of q, choosing the forebear farthest from the root when several qualify. A node may serve as a forebear of itself. Write that node x.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
